== Description ==

A Friday Cube Draft match at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025: [[AJ Hatoum]] (right, grey T-shirt, clear glasses) facing a player in a pink cap and long beard (left, face hidden under cap brim).

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Teacher, 3 October 2025 (13:50 PDT): "All the cards!". Original file name: IMG_8117.jpg (5712×4284, 3.0 MB); Slack file id F09J7NP1887. Scaled here to 3095×2321 to fit the wiki's 2 MB upload limit.
* '''Shared by:''' Teacher (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 3 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' [[AJ Hatoum]] (right): face, grey T-shirt, glasses and watch match [[:File:2025 World Championship Cube Draft table 1.jpg]]. The opponent on the left (pink cap, long beard, black T-shirt) wears the same cap as [[Garrett Larson]] in [[:File:2025 World Championship hall 3 October.jpg]], with his face hidden by the cap.
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
